here is a update on the game

It creates around 10 to 16 rooms in various shapes, mainly rectangles, but also includes some L shapes, crosses, and circles. When it places a room, it chooses a random spot and checks if it intersects with any existing rooms. If not, it carves it out. and ye.

Next, it connects all the rooms with hallways that are 2 tiles wide. Each room. links to the next one, and then it adds extra random connections to create loops instead of just one path. The hallways go either horizontal then vertical, or vertical then horizontal.

The 2 tile width is much better than those narrow 1 tile hallways that are hard to navigate. It only shows what is on your screen, so it doesn't lag, even though the map is 70 by 70 tiles.
